parse.title: Monkey D. Luffy
parse.wikitext: '''Monkey D. Luffy''', commonly known as '''"Straw Hat Luffy"''',{{Qref|name=Epithet}} is the founder and [[Pirate Captain|captain]] of the [[Straw Hat Pirates]].{{Qref|chap=455|page=14|ep=349|[[Nami]] refers to the "Monster Trio".}}{{Qref|chap=606|page=5|ep=525|[[Caribou]] refers to the "Monster Trio".}} He pursues the [[One Piece|legendary treasure]] of the late [[Gol D. Roger]]{{Qref|chap=1|page=44-45|ep=4|Luffy first reveals his dream to Shanks.}}{{Qref|chap=585|page=12-13|ep=496|Luffy tells his brothers his dream.}} According to [[Eiichiro Oda]] in [[SBS Volume 37|Volume 37 SBS]], Luffy does not know how to dress stylishly.{{Qref|name=sbs37|sbs=37|page=26|Oda explains.}} His Davy Back Fight outfit is seen in color.{{Qref|vol=33|Luffy's outfit for the Davy Back Fight is seen in color.}}
